changelog:
# Changelog

## 1.2
- Mode/Fan: replaced cycle-on-OK carousel with a dropdown list overlay (browse freely, confirm to send, Back to cancel)
- Setup screen: more compact layout, now shows app version at the bottom
- Main screen: normalized +/- icon stroke weight, rebalanced vertical spacing
- Removed unused state-cycling API and empty icon assets config

## 1.1
- Non-blocking IR transmission
- Improved state serialization with last_active_mode
- Fixed UI display and input handling
- CI/CD workflow improvements

## 1.0
- Initial release
- Full HTW AC IR protocol support
- All AC modes, fan speeds, temperature control
- Toggle functions (Swing, Turbo, Fresh, LED, Clean)
- Timer scheduling (0.5h - 24h)
- Settings persistence to SD card
description:
Infrared remote control application for HTW air conditioners.

## Features
- All AC modes: Cool, Auto, Dry, Heat, Fan
- Fan speed: Auto, Low, Medium, High
- Temperature: 17°C - 30°C
- Toggle: Swing, Turbo, Fresh, LED, Clean
- Timer scheduling: 0.5h - 24h
- Settings saved to SD card

## Usage
Navigate with D-pad, press OK to activate. Back to exit.
